blocks.text: Aap jaante hain ke saalon se organisms (jandaron) ko kingdoms mein baantne ke liye kai tareeqe (schemes) pesh kiye gaye hain. Chapter 1 mein aap ne parha ke Robert H. Whittaker ka five-kingdom classification system biology mein recommend kiya jata hai. Yeh system organisms ko aise comprehensive (har pehlu ko shamil karne wale) tareeqe se classify karta hai jo un ki evolutionary history (irtiqa ki kahani) ko zahir karta hai. Is system ke mutabiq tamam prokaryotes ek alag kingdom, yani kingdom Monera, mein rakhe gaye hain.

blocks.title: Yaad karein (Recalling)
blocks.text: Robert H. Whittaker ne zindagi ki paanch kingdoms pesh keen: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Pehli kingdom (Monera) mein prokaryotes aate hain aur baqi chaar mein eukaryotes.

Pichhle das saal mein molecular studies ne five-kingdom system mein sanjeeda flaws (khamiyan) dikhayi hain. Chapter 1 mein aap ne yeh bhi parha ke aksar biologists is ki jagah ek naya system, three-domain system, lana pasand karte hain. Yeh molecular studies se milne wale data se zyada mel khata hai.

Aap jaante hain ke bacteria woh prokaryotes hain jinhen un ki apni domain, yani domain Bacteria, mein rakha gaya hai. Is chapter mein hum bacterial cell ki tafseeli structure (banawat) parhenge. Hum bacteria ki ahmiyat bhi parhenge.

Bacteria ek diverse (kai qisam wala) group hain aur sab ki organization unicellular prokaryotic hai: in mein membrane bounded organelles nahin hote, yahan tak ke saaf (well-defined) nucleus bhi nahin hota. In ki cellular organization sab se saada (simplest) hai.

blocks.alt: Ek rod-shaped bacterium jo upar baayen se neeche daayen tirchha (slanted) para hai, khola hua. Bahar se andar: capsule, cell wall aur cell membrane, phir cytoplasm jis mein ribosomes, ek mesosome, plasmid ka chhalla aur nucleoid jis mein DNA hai. Satah se pili nikle hain aur neeche daayen sire se flagellum nikalta hai. Baayen labels: Ribosome, Mesosome, Plasmid; daayen: Capsule, Cell wall, Cell membrane, DNA, Pilus, Nucleoid (containing DNA), Cytoplasm, Flagellum.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar se andar teen tehain (layers) dekhein: halki hari capsule, neeli cell wall aur narangi cell membrane. Membrane ki andar ki taraf mudi hui teh (infolding) mesosome hai. Darmiyan ka halka jamuni ilaqa nucleoid hai aur us ke andar ki gol lipti lakeer bacterium ka ek hi circular DNA hai. Chhota peela chhalla plasmid hai, lal nuqtay ribosomes (70S) hain, chhote baal jaise dhaage pili hain aur lambi lehrdaar dum flagellum hai.
